rounds.text: BLS International Services Ltd is demonstrating exceptional operational profitability, evidenced by an extraordinary return on equity of 103.0% [E13] and a ROCE of 28.34% outperforming the sector benchmark of 8.25% [E10]. The business is compounding at a rapid pace, with trailing twelve-month profit growth hitting 374% [E21] and sales growing 52% over the same period [E17]. This fundamental outperformance is further underscored by sector tailwinds in Consumer Services with a tailwind score of +0.83 [E79], alongside a strong 5-year profit growth CAGR of 38.1% recognized by Screener [E60]. The company has drastically improved its financial health by reducing its borrowings from Rs 70 Cr down to Rs 13 Cr in Mar 2026, achieving a conservatively financed debt-to-equity ratio of 0.14x [E37, E38]. Conceded: the stock trades at an elevated price-to-book ratio of 108.04x [E2] and a P/E of 97.1 [E1], while a discounted cash flow model suggests an overvaluation with a margin of safety of -137.3% [E45].

BLS International Services Ltd is demonstrating exceptional operational profitability and growth that dwarfs broader sector averages, highlighted by an extraordinary trailing twelve-month compounded profit growth of 374% [E21] and a massive net profit increase of 3500% year-on-year [E70]. The company’s core efficiency metrics are world-class, delivering an astronomical return on equity of 103.0% [E13] and a return on capital employed of 28.34% against a paltry sector benchmark of 8.25% [E10]. Furthermore, the business is exceptionally well-capitalized with a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.14x [E37], having successfully slashed borrowings down to Rs 13 Cr from Rs 70 Cr a year earlier [E38]. This elite financial health is paired with powerful momentum in the top line, featuring a 52% compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months [E17] and a strong consumer services sector tailwind score of +0.83 [E79]. Conceded: [E1] and [E2] and [E44].
